entries.63161c8ff13a0687: This business develops, distributes and operates free-to-play online games for smartphones and is the only segment of the group. The securities report describes this business as divided into two parts: 'online game distribution services' and 'online game production and operation outsourcing services.' Net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥15,826 million (down 7% year on year), and operating profit was ¥2,079 million (the prior year was an operating loss of ¥552 million). The securities report states that the company specializes in developing massively multiplayer online (MMO) games, a genre in which large numbers of players interact simultaneously over a network. The main sources of net sales are three titles: 'Sword and Magic Logres: Inishie no Megami,' 'Dragon Quest Tact,' and 'Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! Master of Garden.'
entries.631831a7685ad935: The company was established in 2011 and has focused exclusively on the online game business since its founding. The securities report states that the company is strong in developing games in the MMO (massively multiplayer online) genre. Game development is project-based, and the company also has a development base in Taiwan. Some titles are developed as joint businesses with other companies, and the company also uses affiliated companies in the form of production committees.

entries.87197f6148ad54bf: A service that distributes free-to-play online games, mainly for smartphones. Users are charged when they obtain certain items or use paid features, and these paid charges become revenue. The Group may also license its games to other distributors and earn usage fee revenue. Games are distributed mainly through Google Play and the App Store, and some titles are run as joint businesses with other companies, sharing revenue with the joint business partners while splitting development and promotion costs. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were down 22.1% from the previous fiscal year.
